{{rt|17|Kalos}} }} '''Hawlucha Attacks''' (Japanese: '''ルチャブル、襲う''' ''{{tt|Luchabull|Hawlucha}}, Attack'') is the 584th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 36th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * As [[Professor Sycamore]] waits, {{adv|Zygarde}} appears behind him. * {{adv|Blue}} and [[Diantha]] meet with [[Gurkinn]] at the [[Lost Hotel]]. * Blue is revealed to be a [[Mega Evolution]] Successor. * {{adv|X}} and his friends arrive in [[Anistar City]], only to find Professor Sycamore under attack. * X's {{p|Pinsir}} is revealed to be named Rute while Y's {{p|Absol}} is named Solsol. * Together, X and Y rescue Professor Sycamore. * Sycamore reveals that due to the [[ultimate weapon]] firing on [[Kalos]], X and Y are now able to search for [[Mega Stone]]s between 8 PM and 9 PM. * X and Y give their [[Mega Ring]]s to {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} so that they may find the Mega Stones for Rute and Solsol. * [[Emma|Essentia]] watches the event from afar, but is spotted by Y. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Hawlucha}} * {{p|Zygarde}} (50% Forme) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|X}} * {{adv|Y}} * {{adv|Trevor}} * {{adv|Tierno}} * {{adv|Shauna}} * [[Professor Sycamore]] * [[Ramos]] * [[Diantha]] * [[Gurkinn]] * [[Emma|Essentia]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}) * {{p|Rhyperior}} ({{OP|Blue|Rhyperior}}) * {{p|Kangaskhan}} ([[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]];
